name: personal-agent
description: A personal assistant for macOS in Codex: Apple Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Mail (reads mail, saves drafts, never sends), tasks the user asks it to remember, a 今日 note, a weekly journal, morning and evening checks, and six personalities. Shares its data with the DSH Personal Agent plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Your Mac calendar, reminders, mail and to-dos, in Chinese
interface.longDescription: Personal Agent works with Apple Calendar, Reminders, Notes and Mail through a small signed helper app: it reads your calendar and mail, creates and moves events and reminders after you confirm, saves mail drafts but never sends, records the things you ask it to remember, keeps a 今日 note and a weekly journal, and runs morning and evening checks. It speaks Chinese by default and has six personalities. Everything stays on your Mac.
defaultPrompt: $personal-agent 帮我记住周五前要交申请材料
